description: This file implements a gRPC resolver that manages both target URI and proxy address resolution by delegating to separate child resolvers. It includes logic for proxy detection, resolver creation, state updates, and address management, specifically for the 'delegatingresolver' package within gRPC internal resolver infrastructure.

classes.name: delegatingResolver
classes.description: A resolver that manages both target URI and proxy address resolution by delegating to child resolvers, implementing the resolver.Resolver interface.

classes.name: nopResolver
classes.description: A no-operation resolver that does nothing, used as a default placeholder.

classes.name: wrappingClientConn
classes.description: A helper struct that implements resolver.ClientConn interface, forwarding calls to the parent delegatingResolver for state updates, error reporting, and address updates.

methods.name: proxyURLForTarget
methods.description: Determines the proxy URL for a given target address based on environment variables.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new delegating resolver capable of resolving target URIs and proxy addresses, setting up child resolvers as needed.

methods.name: proxyURIResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for resolving proxy URIs using the DNS scheme.

methods.name: ResolveNow
methods.description: Triggers resolution on both target and proxy resolvers.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the resolver and its child resolvers.

methods.name: updateClientConnStateLocked
methods.description: Constructs and updates the combined address list for the client connection based on target and proxy resolver states.

methods.name: updateProxyResolverState
methods.description: Updates the proxy resolver state and triggers address updates.

methods.name: updateTargetResolverState
methods.description: Updates the target resolver state, initializes proxy resolver if needed, and triggers address updates.

methods.name: UpdateState
methods.description: Forwards resolver state updates to the appropriate listener.

methods.name: ReportError
methods.description: Reports errors to the parent ClientConn.

methods.name: NewAddress
methods.description: Handles new address updates from child resolvers.

methods.name: ParseServiceConfig
methods.description: Parses a service configuration JSON string.
